display_information.name: Slatebox
display_information.description: Bring Slack threads onto a shared canvas your team edits.
display_information.long_description: Slatebox is a free, open-source team canvas. Connect Slack once, then ask about your channels and threads from a slate. Answers land as suggested notes you keep or discard. Posting to Slack always waits for your approval. Slate links posted in Slack show a preview, but only for public slates. Use Send to slate on any message to put it on a slate. The agent can be inaccurate, so check important details against the original messages. Slatebox never trains models on Slack data.

shortcuts.name: Send to slate
shortcuts.description: Put this message on a Slatebox slate you pick.
